page.layout: One page of handwritten Latin text in the upper half, with red numerals in the left margin and a number at the right. The lower half holds faint, largely illegible handwriting. No printed page, column or running head.

main_text.p: non est Reductio ad quarto Inter honestum et non honestum Sed Ratio ngm abire pt In nāam non rationis Scientia non pt deiici ad opinionem, nedu ad errorem nec Iure potest Opinio gaudere priuilegijs Scientiæ.
Virtus non pt deiici ad Vitium [?] recula fallit sed non est falsa o° non ipsa sed abitens e[?]nas[?] t[?]ers [?] fallit.

page.notes: Handwritten manuscript, not a printed page. Red numerals in the left margin, "17.819" and "17.818", are marginal marks and are not transcribed as text. The number "8003" at the right is a page or folio number, copied as printed. The lower half is too faint to read, so those lines are marked illegible and their lengths are estimates. The reading of the first lines is partly uncertain, especially the abbreviations and the words at line ends.
